ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bhagyanagar India Limited (BIL) has announced October 8, 2026, as the record date for a significant corporate restructuring under a Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited (BCPL) and Tieramet Limited (Resulting Company). Shareholders of the 'Demerged Company' will receive one fully paid-up equity share of Tieramet Limited for every one equity share held in the 'Demerged Company'. This transaction will materially impact the capital structure of the involved entities and alter the asset composition for affected shareholders, with no explicit red flags identified in the provided document.
